svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Minimal Local Tag mark, v5
svg.desc: The unlettered soft-green tag makes the identical right and bottom lobes clearest. A single exterior contour and two identically spaced openings carry the tag and local-point idea. The right and bottom lobe segments are exact reflections across x equals y, with equal six-unit-radius openings at reflected positions. Original, unadopted concept with editable lettering.
